narrative.overview:
SIJAGA's interface is a secure chamber for academic credentials. Every surface communicates containment and protection: deep backgrounds that absorb light, glass panels that reveal depth without exposing internals, and a single crimson accent that signals attention the way a vault's status light does. The system is not decorative; it is architectural.

The glassmorphism is deliberate, not decorative. Semi-transparent panels with backdrop blur create a sense of layered security, as if looking through reinforced glass at the data behind it. This is the one domain where blur earns its keep: it reinforces the vault metaphor rather than decorating it.

This system explicitly rejects: generic crypto/neon aesthetics, playful fintech patterns, legacy university portal design, and glassmorphism used for its own sake without spatial purpose.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal depth hierarchy from abyss (#0A0A0F) through vault (#111118) to surface (#1A1A24)
Single crimson accent used sparingly for primary actions, status indicators, and emphasis
Glass panels for elevated containers that need spatial context
Dense information layout appropriate to a tool, not a marketing page
Consistent component vocabulary across admin, student, and public surfaces

rules.name: The 10% Rule
rules.body: The crimson accent is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Tonal Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Background depth follows: abyss → vault → surface → surface-elevated. Never skip a layer.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk is the only typeface. Do not introduce a second font. Weight contrast provides all hierarchy.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Product UI is dense by nature. Body at 0.875rem with 1.6 line-height is the baseline.

rules.name: The Purposeful Blur Rule
rules.body: Glass panels are used only for containers that need spatial context. If it doesn't float, it doesn't blur.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glows appear only as responses to state.

dos: Do use the tonal depth hierarchy (abyss → vault → surface → surface-elevated) for all container layering.
Do keep the crimson accent to ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity signals importance.
Do use glass panels only for containers that float above content (nav, modals, elevated cards).
Do maintain 4.5:1 contrast for all text against its background.
Do use Space Grotesk at the defined weights and sizes. No additional fonts.
Do use semantic color variants (emerald for success, amber for warning, sky for info) consistently.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism for containers that sit flat on the page surface.
Don't use gradient text anywhere except the SIJAGA brand name in the navigation.
Don't use the crimson accent for backgrounds, large surfaces, or decorative elements.
Don't use neon gradients, glowing borders, or excessive animation.
Don't use generic crypto/Web3 dashboard aesthetics with purple gradients and neon accents.
Don't use legacy university portal design patterns.
Don't use playful fintech patterns that undersell the gravity of academic credentials.
